content.query:
DELETE FROM EDS.CCD_CBCEXSMTTP WHERE AS_OF_DATE = @Datetoprocess;

INSERT INTO EDS.CCD_CBCEXSMTTP
(
    AS_OF_DATE
,   SMTT_TXN_BANK_NBR
,   SMTT_TXN_PDT_NBR
,   SMTT_TXN_ACCT_NBR
,   SMTT_STM_DATE
,   SMTT_TXN_CARD_NBR
,   SMTT_TXN_DTE
,   SMTT_TXN_CODE
,   FLAG_SMTT_TXN_AMT
,   SMTT_TXN_AMT
,   SMTT_TXN_POSTING_DTE
,   SMTT_TXN_CURR_CODE
,   SMTT_TXN_SOURCE
,   SMTT_TXN_AUTH_CODE
,   SMTT_TXN_JUL_DTE
,   SMTT_TXN_BATCH_NBR
,   SMTT_TXN_BATCH_SEQ
,   SMTT_TXN_DESC
,   SMTT_TXN_ZIP_CODE
,   SMTT_TXN_STATE
,   SMTT_MCC_CODE
,   SMTT_TXN_ACQ_REF
,   SMTT_TXN_PRE_CURR_CODE
,   FLAG_SMTT_TXN_PRE_ORG_AMT
,   SMTT_TXN_PRE_ORG_AMT
,   SMTT_TXN_ORG_CURR_CODE
,   FLAG_SMTT_TXN_ORG_AMT
,   SMTT_TXN_ORG_AMT
,   SMTT_TXN_SETL_CURR_CODE
,   FLAG_SMTT_TXN_SETL_AMT
,   SMTT_TXN_SETL_AMT
,   SMTT_TXN_SETL_FLAG
,   SMTT_TXN_REIM_ATTR
,   SMTT_IFI_IND
,   SMTT_PSI_IND
,   SMTT_MAIL_TEL_IND
,   SMTT_OTH_PROC_IND
,   SMTT_POS_ENTRY_MODE
,   SMTT_DMS_CASE_NBR
,   SMTT_MECH_BANK_NBR
,   SMTT_MECH_NBR
,   SMTT_NODE_ID
,   SMTT_ROOT_NODE_ID
,   SMTT_ADDN_REF
,   SMTT_FILE_BUFFER
,   SMTT_TXN_FILE_DATE
,   LAST6_SMTT_TXN_ACCT_NBR
,	BNK_CODE
,	SOURCE_CODE
,	FILE_NAME
,	insert_dttm
)

SELECT 
@Datetoprocess AS AS_OF_DATE
,   SMTT_TXN_BANK_NBR
,   SMTT_TXN_PDT_NBR
,   SMTT_TXN_ACCT_NBR
,   SMTT_STM_DATE
,   SMTT_TXN_CARD_NBR
,   SMTT_TXN_DTE
,   SMTT_TXN_CODE
,   FLAG_SMTT_TXN_AMT
,   SMTT_TXN_AMT
,   SMTT_TXN_POSTING_DTE
,   SMTT_TXN_CURR_CODE
,   SMTT_TXN_SOURCE
,   SMTT_TXN_AUTH_CODE
,   SMTT_TXN_JUL_DTE
,   SMTT_TXN_BATCH_NBR
,   SMTT_TXN_BATCH_SEQ
,   SMTT_TXN_DESC
,   SMTT_TXN_ZIP_CODE
,   SMTT_TXN_STATE
,   SMTT_MCC_CODE
,   SMTT_TXN_ACQ_REF
,   SMTT_TXN_PRE_CURR_CODE
,   FLAG_SMTT_TXN_PRE_ORG_AMT
,   SMTT_TXN_PRE_ORG_AMT
,   SMTT_TXN_ORG_CURR_CODE
,   FLAG_SMTT_TXN_ORG_AMT
,   SMTT_TXN_ORG_AMT
,   SMTT_TXN_SETL_CURR_CODE
,   FLAG_SMTT_TXN_SETL_AMT
,   SMTT_TXN_SETL_AMT
,   SMTT_TXN_SETL_FLAG
,   SMTT_TXN_REIM_ATTR
,   SMTT_IFI_IND
,   SMTT_PSI_IND
,   SMTT_MAIL_TEL_IND
,   SMTT_OTH_PROC_IND
,   SMTT_POS_ENTRY_MODE
,   SMTT_DMS_CASE_NBR
,   SMTT_MECH_BANK_NBR
,   SMTT_MECH_NBR
,   SMTT_NODE_ID
,   SMTT_ROOT_NODE_ID
,   SMTT_ADDN_REF
,   SMTT_FILE_BUFFER
,   SMTT_TXN_FILE_DATE
,   LAST6_SMTT_TXN_ACCT_NBR
,	left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
,	substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
,	FILE_NAME
,	CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME) as insert_dttm
FROM D360.STG_EDS_CCD_CBCEXSMTTP
WHERE H = 'D'
